items.name: Microverse
items.description: A god-simulation sandbox game built on Godot 4 as a multi-agent AI social simulation system. In this virtual world, AI characters possess independent thinking and memory, capable of autonomous social interactions, task completion, and developing complex social relationships through continuous communication.

items.name: concordia
items.description: A library for generative social simulation

items.name: AgentSociety
items.description: AgentSociety 2 is a modern, LLM-native agent simulation platform designed for social science research and experimental design. It provides a flexible framework for creating and managing intelligent agents in simulated environments.

items.name: Agentshire
items.description: OpenClaw / QClaw  plugin that visualizes AI agents as 3D NPCs in a game town — with social simulation, a map editor, and a character workshop.

items.name: qq-bridge
items.description: Bridge between QQ (SnowLuma OneBot v11) and DeepSeek Harness agents: social simulation, safe MCP tools, slang learning and more.

items.name: AgentMaps
items.description: Make social simulations on real maps! Agent-based modeling for the web.

items.name: Agent-Kernel
items.description: A MicroKernel Multi-Agents System Framework for Adaptive Social Simulation Powered by LLMs

items.name: Stable-Alignment
items.description: Multi-agent Social Simulation + Efficient, Effective, and Stable alternative of RLHF. Code for the paper "Training Socially Aligned Language Models in Simulated Human Society".

items.name: FreeAskWorld
items.description: [AAAI 2026 Oral] FreeAskWorld is an interactive simulation framework that integrates large language models (LLMs) for high-level planning and socially grounded interaction in embodied AI.

items.name: BlackWave
items.description: AI-powered single-user social network simulation. Post like on Twitter, and receive real-time, character-driven reactions from hundreds of AI bots. Open source, local-first, and built for experimentation.

items.name: AnthropomorphicIntelligence
items.description: Advancing AI by embracing human-likeness for better AI understanding, human–AI collaboration, and social simulation, bridging technology and genuine human experience.

items.description: Differentiable Social Force simulation with universal interaction potentials.

items.name: awesome-social-agents
items.description: A collection of works that investigate social agents, simulations and their real-world impact in text, embodied, and robotics contexts.

items.name: agent-campus
items.description: A multi-agent campus social simulation built with LangGraph, featuring memory, RAG, personality evolution, and durable execution.
